mapper.select: SELECT exchange_id, account_id, order_id, provisional_amount, provisional_at, final_rate, final_amount, final_at, settlement_status FROM krw_exchange WHERE exchange_id = #{exchangeId}
SELECT exchange_id, account_id, order_id, provisional_amount, provisional_at, final_rate, final_amount, final_at, settlement_status FROM krw_exchange WHERE exchange_id = #{exchangeId} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE krw_exchange SET final_rate = #{finalRate}, final_amount = #{finalAmount}, final_at = #{finalAt}, settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' WHERE exchange_id = #{exchangeId} AND settlement_status = 'PROVISIONAL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO krw_exchange ( account_id, order_id, provisional_amount, provisional_at, settlement_status ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{orderId}, #{provisionalAmount}, #{provisionalAt}, 'PROVISIONAL' )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM krw_exchange WHERE final_at >= #{start} AND final_at < #{end} AND settlement_status = 'FINALIZED'
